description: Receive a file archive over a one-shot throwaway-TLS listener and write it to a path on this host. With port and output it starts a detached listener and returns at once with the listener cert fingerprint and a transfer id. With status (a transfer id) and the same output it reports pending, received (byte count and sha256), failed or timedout.

port.description: TCP port to listen on (receive call).

output.description: Output path for the received archive on this host (both calls: the status file lives in its directory).

timeout.description: Seconds the listener waits for the connection and transfer (receive call, default 300).

status.description: Transfer id returned by an earlier receive call; makes this a status call.
